verdict.rationale: Independent hands-on reviews (TechPowerUp, Tom's Hardware) confirm the 9950X3D delivers leading gaming/single-thread-heavy interactive performance, beating Intel's 285K/14900K and matching the 9800X3D, while retaining strong productivity throughput — exactly the 'instant everyday responsiveness' claim backed by benchmarks rather than marketing GHz figures. Missing for 10: a dedicated pure single-thread benchmark (e.g., Cinebench 1T) figure isn't explicitly cited, only aggregate gaming/productivity results.
